welcome: 👋 Hello, {name}! 📄 I work with documents: PDF, Word and images. 📎 Send a file or pick an action below.
help:
ℹ️ How to use:

1. 📎 Send a PDF, Word file or image.
2. 👇 Pick an action.
3. ✅ Get the result.

Commands:
/start — start
/menu — menu
/profile — profile
/premium — subscription
/help — help
/language — language
/cancel — cancel

🆓 Free: {limit} actions a day, files up to {free_mb} MB.
⭐ Premium: unlimited, up to {prem_mb} MB, custom cover, no watermark.
unknown: 🤔 I didn't understand that. Use the menu or send /help.
choose_action: 📎 File received: {name} 👇 What should I do?
choose_action_hint: 👇 Tap a button below or send /cancel.
ask_images: 🖼 Send an image (JPG or PNG). Then tap Done.
ask_merge: 🧩 Send PDF files one by one (at least 2). Then tap Merge.
ask_any_file: 📎 Send the file you want to rename or give a cover.
ask_pages_split: ✂️ Which pages should I keep? Example: 3-7 or 1,3,5
ask_pages_delete: 🗑 Which pages should I delete? Example: 2 or 2-4
ask_pages_rotate: 🔁 Which pages should I rotate? Example: 1-3 or all
ask_angle: 🔄 How many degrees should I rotate?
ask_new_name: 🏷 Send the new name. I will add the extension. Current: {name}
ask_thumb: 🖼 Send a picture for the cover. I will fit it into 320 px and 200 KB.
edit_intro: ✏️ File: {name} Change the name or cover, then tap Done.
busy: ⏳ The previous action is still running. Please wait.
rate_limit: ⚠️ Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
bad_file: ⚠️ This file type does not match. Send the right format.
bad_pdf: ⚠️ The PDF could not be opened. The file may be damaged.
pdf_protected: 🔒 This PDF is password-protected. Removing the password comes in a later version.
file_too_big: 📦 The file is too large. Your limit is {max_mb} MB.
error_generic: ❌ Something went wrong. Check the file and send it again.
timeout: ⏱ The job ran longer than 60 seconds and was stopped. Try a smaller file.
libreoffice_missing: ⚠️ Word → PDF needs LibreOffice installed on the computer.
bad_pages: ⚠️ That page range is invalid. The file has {total} pages. Try again.
keep_one: ⚠️ You can't delete every page. At least one must remain.
too_many_pages: ⚠️ Too many pages (limit: {max}). Split the file first.
limit_reached:
🚫 Today's free limit is used up ({limit}).
⭐ Get Premium for unlimited actions.
limit_last: ⚠️ That was the last free action for today.
thumb_premium: ⭐ A custom cover is a Premium feature. Renaming is free.
thumb_bad: ⚠️ Could not read the image. Send a JPG or PNG.
premium_intro:
⭐ Premium means unlimited actions, a larger file and no watermark.

🆓 Free: {limit} a day, up to {free_mb} MB.
💎 Premium: unlimited, up to {prem_mb} MB, custom cover.
🏷 Free results include a small label.

✅ Premium turns on after payment. A card payment is confirmed by an admin.
card_info: 💳 For {plan}, transfer {amount} UZS. Card: {card} 👤 Holder: {holder} 🧾 Then send a photo of the receipt.
card_missing: ⚠️ The card number is not set yet. Choose Stars or contact the admin.
receipt_bad: 🧾 Send the receipt as a photo.
receipt_sent: ✅ Receipt sent. Premium opens after an admin confirms it.
payment_approved:
✅ Payment confirmed. Premium is on for {days} days.
📅 Until: {until}
reminder:
⏰ Your Premium ends on {date} (within 3 days).
⭐ Renew: /premium
invoice_desc: {plan} of Premium. Unlimited actions and no watermark.
not_admin: 🔒 This command is for admins only.
ask_grant_days: 📅 How many days of Premium? Example: 30
ask_revoke_id: 🆔 Send the Telegram ID to remove Premium from.
grant_ok_no_dm: ✅ Premium saved: {user_id}, {days} days. The user has not opened the bot yet. It starts after /start.
grant_notice:
🎉 You received Premium for {days} days.
📅 Until: {until}
bad_number: ⚠️ That number is invalid. Send it again.
ask_reject_reason: ✍️ Write the rejection reason. The user will see this text.
text_too_long: ⚠️ The text is too long. Shorten it and send again.
file_ready: 📎 File received: {name} Tap one of the buttons below.
